headline: Vehicle purchases, up to $575,000 in winter road salt, and leases for two parking garages.
summary: Most items are equipment and vehicle purchases, along with wastewater studies and sewer work. Two resolutions would authorize the mayor to sign parking garage leases with Nashua Apartment Ventures, LLC.
